# UNIQUE BLUEPRINT 0074 R01

## Binding and source identity

- Project: TTQS_ONE; this artifact is a **candidate only**.
- Document ID: **0074**.
- Requirement ID: **I17A-E02**.
- Official checkbox serial: **081**. The checkbox serial is not the document ID.
- Indicator: **17**, sub-item **17a Reaction Evaluation**, closed out inside a course closeout report.
- Live source branch: `work/ttqs-one-document-quality-contract-20261016`; source head at packet preparation `c5822ed3e91716799e9a79873529c25c90506bdd`; PR #92 is an open Draft.

- Inventory finding bound to this candidate: **do not mark this item complete**. The historical file is only a working draft; real association practice, records, approval and outcomes are not confirmed.
- Unique checkbox Blueprint source: `docs/ttqs-quality-20261016/03_157_CHECKBOX_BLUEPRINTS.md`, Git blob `8c2bbe7ca9dcbb03088a48934b9e57e7147ede63`. Official 081 Blueprint text: 「反應評估納入結案：分析、課程規劃與開課建議」.
- Genre writing manual source: `docs/ttqs-quality-20261016/02_GENRE_WRITING_MANUAL.md`, Git blob `4ff863d9f534b6359fc1c7c1685bd8cce02da886`; indicator 17a.
- Cross-document artifact referenced by this candidate (do not rewrite, do not overstate): DOCX 0073 = I17A-E01 = official checkbox 080; candidate exact SHA-256 `a454cf0691a53173ae7838c9cd84522cf419d1d940cb63a7ddc168b497bc9b13`; status CANDIDATE, `REAL=UNKNOWN/HOLD`.
- Positive neighbor check (must remain un-invented): DOCX 0075 = I17A-E03 = official checkbox 082 is the next requirement; no verified follow-up result exists yet, so no 0075 completion, decision or outcome may be asserted.
- Historical 0073 outputs and any archived DOCX bodies are discovery/history only; this blueprint requires a rebuild, not a copy of prior body text.

## Official 081 requirement content (four mandatory elements)

Official 081 Blueprint text: 「反應評估納入結案：分析、課程規劃與開課建議」. Per the checkbox Blueprint, an acceptable item must carry all four of the following and may not substitute empty fields for evidence:

1. **Specific source location** — a named, locatable record (form page, file, table, row, ID), not a vague reference.
2. **Substantive body or example** — real usable content, a completed worked example, or a filled instrument.
3. **Result or decision** — an outcome, conclusion, comparison, or decision record, even if it is a conditional or pending decision.
4. **Factual links to other documents** — traceable cross-document facts (case key, artifact SHA, upstream/downstream document IDs).

The genre writing manual (indicator 17a) additionally requires: showing questionnaire items/scales/options, valid-return counts, a denominator-defined response rate, identification of group/low-scoring items, instructor and learner qualitative feedback, and concrete improvements — and the closure/improvement recommendation must cite the **same returned data**.

## Unique document purpose and genre

Genre: a **course closeout report** a training administrator can actually fill in and a TTQS evaluator can inspect. It must be recognizably broader than 0073's satisfaction-and-feedback analysis. Required scope: training objective and plan-vs-delivery comparison; enrollment/attendance/completion arithmetic; instructor, materials, time, site, safety and resource accounting; a learning check with aggregates; questionnaire disposition and full item statistics; issues and limits; a closure conclusion; a comparison of next-offering design alternatives; a **conditional** opening recommendation with owner role, due event and measures; record retention; and hold/rejection criteria. It must contain one complete filled SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC example plus a separate practical replacement/checklist section for real use.

Reader: association training administrator (primary) and TTQS evaluator/internal reviewer (secondary). It is used after a course when a questionnaire has been returned and analyzed, when a learning check has been administered, and when a closure/decision record is needed.

### Distinction from DOCX 0073 (I17A-E01 / checkbox 080)

0073 owns the **post-course satisfaction analysis plus multi-stakeholder feedback record** (learner questionnaire statistics and instructor/HR/department-manager comments). 0074 must not be a duplicate of that analysis. 0074 **consumes** the questionnaire disposition and item statistics as one input, then adds what 0073 does not own: plan-vs-delivery comparison, enrollment/attendance/completion arithmetic, resource and safety accounting, a learning check, exception analysis, alternative comparison, and a conditional opening recommendation for the next offering. 0074 must not restate 0073's questionnaire as its own new survey, and must not rewrite 0073.

### Distinction from DOCX 0075 (I17A-E03 / checkbox 082)

0075 is the next requirement and is **not yet a verified follow-up result**. 0074 may describe a pending, conditional recommendation whose effect would only be observed later; it may not claim that 0075 exists, is approved, or has measured any result. Any follow-up evidence is `REAL=UNKNOWN/HOLD`.

## Status vocabulary (used consistently across all three files)

| Label | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `PLANNED` | Intended before delivery (may still be changed). |
| `SAMPLE-OBSERVED` | The illustrative delivered value, synthetic. |
| `PROPOSED` | A synthetic proposal, not a decision. |
| `PENDING APPROVAL` | Awaiting an authorized association decision; not yet decided. |
| `REAL=UNKNOWN/HOLD` | Real association record not yet obtained; held. |

The following values are reused by instruction from 0073 R08 and remain synthetic: case key `SYN-0073-2026-A01`; sample course date `2026-08-15`; issued 16 / returned 16 / valid 15 / invalid 1 (S16 invalid because 3 of 8 items blank); eight-item reaction summary; sum of item totals 479; valid item-responses 120; overall mean 3.9917 → 3.99; positive 90/120 = 75.00%; Q5 is the lowest item and its wording is 實作練習時間足以完成交接與紀錄步驟. The 0073 sample thresholds (mean < 4.00, positive rate < 80%) are **illustrative only** and are not approved association policy.

## Controlled additional synthetic values (all invented solely to complete the demonstration)

- Demonstration title: `志工服務溝通與紀錄交接實務` (explicitly a sample label; 0073 did not supply a real course title).
- Plan target 18; enrolled 16; attended 16; completed 16. Target attainment 16/18 = 88.89%; attended completers 16/16 = 100.00%.
- One-day plan 2026-08-15, 09:00–16:00, six instructional hours plus breaks; outline: objective/role framing; service-record fields and privacy; staged communication example; record writing; handoff workflow; guided roleplay/checklist; knowledge/performance check; evaluation and close.
- Skills check IDs P01–P16 (synthetic). Pre /100 and post /100 paired scores as supplied; pre total 870, mean 54.375 → 54.38; post total 1265, mean 79.0625 → 79.06; mean change +24.6875 → +24.69; post ≥80 count 9/16 = 56.25%. A synthetic paired demonstration, not causal evidence; no validated assessment instrument is provided.
- Synthetic budget (TWD): plan instructor 3,000; venue 1,200; materials 720; refreshments 800; planned total 5,720. Actual instructor 3,000; venue 1,000; materials 640; refreshments 800; total 5,440; variance −280 (−4.90% of plan); cost per 16 completers 340.
- Next-offering design alternatives (synthetic estimates): A retain current six-hour format ≈ TWD 5,720/run; B add 30 guided practice minutes, a small-group second handoff round and a field-check card ≈ TWD 6,020/run; C split into two 3-hour sessions with prework ≈ TWD 6,600/run. Conditional SAMPLE proposal: **B**, because Q5 is weakest. No approval, booking, instructor appointment or opening is asserted.
- Survey response rates: returned/issued = 16/16 = 100.00%; valid/issued = 15/16 = 93.75%; invalid/returned = 1/16 = 6.25%. Respondent groups must never be mixed into the learner denominator.

## Section-by-section mapping to official 081

| Report section | Official 081 element served | Genre-17a element served |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 Management summary | Result/decision (summary conclusion + conditional recommendation) | improvement must cite returned data |
| 2 Scope and status | Source location + boundary | valid-return counts, denominator rules |
| 3 Source / record map | Specific source location + factual cross-document links | cites 0073 R08 SHA, 0075 pending |
| 4 Planned vs sample delivery | Substantive body/example | plan vs analysis |
| 5 Enrollment/attendance/completion | Result | valid-return counts, denominator-defined rate |
| 6 Full agenda | Substantive body/example | questionnaire context |
| 7 Instructor/materials/site/safety/resources | Source location + result | instructor qualitative feedback |
| 8 Learning check table + aggregates | Substantive body/example + result | learning vs reaction split |
| 9 8-item reaction summary with denominators | Substantive body/example | items/scales, low-scoring item, group feedback |
| 10 Integrated findings | Result/decision | analysis used to revise next course |
| 11 Exception/limitation analysis | Result | bounded claims |
| 12 Three next-offering options | Decision support | concrete improvements |
| 13 Conditional opening recommendation | Decision (explicitly unapproved) | recommendation cites same returned data |
| 14 Closure checklist + decision form | Result/decision instrument | reuse for next course |
| 15 Evidence inventory/retention/privacy | Source location | privacy of returned data |
| 16 Replacement register guidance | Source location | real data substitution |
| 17 Cross-document boundary + conclusion | Factual links to other documents + result | final conclusion |

## Required tables and forms

1. Source/record map table (ID, type, locator, status).
2. Planned vs sample-delivered comparison table.
3. Enrollment/attendance/completion arithmetic table.
4. Course agenda table (time, unit, method, output).
5. Resource accounting table (instructor, materials, time, site, safety, budget).
6. Learning-check per-person pre/post table (P01–P16) plus aggregate table.
7. Eight-item reaction summary table (item, question, total, n, mean, positive n, positive rate).
8. Integrated findings table (finding, reaction evidence, learning evidence, interpretation).
9. Three-option comparison table (option, time, cost, risk, reason, SAMPLE estimate).
10. Conditional opening recommendation record (finding, evidence, proposed change, owner role, due event, measure, hold trigger, status).
11. Real-use closure checklist and closure decision form.
12. Evidence inventory / retention / privacy control table.
13. Replacement-register guidance table.

## Source locators (cite exactly)

- Official requirement inventory: `送審資料/05_填表建議_方法示範不等於實績/142份文件逐項檢查與填表建議.csv` (blob `3ee92744602321a7f27324e4a70b25aaaf015930`), row 17 / I17A-E02.
- Official checkbox Blueprint 081: `docs/ttqs-quality-20261016/03_157_CHECKBOX_BLUEPRINTS.md` (blob `8c2bbe7ca9dcbb03088a48934b9e57e7147ede63`).
- Genre writing manual (17a): `docs/ttqs-quality-20261016/02_GENRE_WRITING_MANUAL.md` (blob `4ff863d9f534b6359fc1c7c1685bd8cce02da886`).
- Training-institution evidence form page: PDF printed page 5 / physical page 5 (official requirement page).
- Referenced survey-analysis artifact: 0073 R08, candidate exact SHA-256 `a454cf0691a53173ae7838c9cd84522cf419d1d940cb63a7ddc168b497bc9b13`.
- Every synthetic dataset table must carry its own locator plus the SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC label.

## Calculation registry (must reconcile exactly)

- Reaction: 15 × 8 = 120 valid item-responses; 61+62+67+57+54+57+58+63 = 479; 479 ÷ 120 = 3.9917 → **3.99**; positive 12+12+14+10+8+10+11+13 = 90; 90 ÷ 120 = **75.00%**.
- Per item means / positive rates: Q1 4.07 / 80.00%; Q2 4.13 / 80.00%; Q3 4.47 / 93.33%; Q4 3.80 / 66.67%; Q5 3.60 / 53.33%; Q6 3.80 / 66.67%; Q7 3.87 / 73.33%; Q8 4.20 / 86.67%.
- Response: returned/issued 16/16 = **100.00%**; valid/issued 15/16 = **93.75%**; invalid/returned 1/16 = **6.25%**.
- Enrollment: target 18; enrolled 16; attended 16; completed 16; attainment 16/18 = **88.89%**; attended completers 16/16 = **100.00%**.
- Learning check: pre total 870, pre mean 870/16 = 54.375 → **54.38**; post total 1265, post mean 1265/16 = 79.0625 → **79.06**; mean change 24.6875 → **+24.69**; post ≥80 = 9/16 = **56.25%**.
- Budget: planned 3,000+1,200+720+800 = **5,720**; actual 3,000+1,000+640+800 = **5,440**; variance 5,440−5,720 = **−280**; −280 ÷ 5,720 = **−4.90%**; 5,440 ÷ 16 = **340** per completer.
- Alternatives: A 5,720; B 6,020; C 6,600 per run (synthetic estimates).

## SAMPLE / REAL boundary

| Category | Content in this candidate | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Course title, date, agenda, hours | 志工服務溝通與紀錄交接實務; 2026-08-15; 09:00–16:00; six hours | SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC |
| Enrollment/attendance/completion (18/16/16/16) | Illustrative | SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC |
| Learning-check P01–P16 scores and aggregates | Synthetic paired demonstration | SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC |
| Budget and per-completer cost | Synthetic, not ledger amounts | SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC |
| Reaction statistics (reused from 0073 R08) | Synthetic sample | SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC |
| Stakeholder qualitative feedback (0073 R08) | Synthetic | SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC |
| Alternative costs, recommendation, conditions | Synthetic proposal, unapproved | SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC; PENDING APPROVAL |
| Real course, roster, ledger, approval, outcome, 0075 follow-up | Not obtained | **REAL=UNKNOWN/HOLD** |

## Acceptance / hold / rejection rules

- If the document binding, official source text, or checkbox mapping differs from this blueprint, stop and report the mismatch; do not silently relabel.
- If any total, denominator, mean, percentage or variance fails recomputation, mark the inconsistency and repair only the data/text mismatch.
- **Hold or reject** the item when any of the following is true: case ID or denominator mismatch; invalid surveys counted as valid; totals fail to reconcile; any synthetic item presented as real; a supporting original is absent; an approval or third-party record is fabricated; the course recommendation is stated as approved; or an unresolved privacy, safety or financial conflict remains.
- Keep `REAL=UNKNOWN/HOLD` throughout until authenticated originals and an actual authorized review exist.
- Do not claim any tier attainment, adoption, execution, booking, appointment, opening or follow-up result.
- No real names, signatures, credentials, approvals or quoted actual third-party opinions. Use only descriptive fictional IDs (P01–P16, S01–S16, T01/H01/M01/M02).

## Typography and formatting target (instruction, not a sourced fact)

- Markdown body intended to render at >= 10.5 pt body text and >= 9.5 pt table text; do not shrink text to force page count.
- Lead the body with a title, purpose, sample status, case ID and closeout conclusion.
- Target roughly 8–14 rendered pages; keep every table readable.
